content: Rounding/drift in countdown progress: (1) NEVER accumulate rounded values - compute progress fresh from a single source of truth (e.g., Date) each tick, then round only for display; (2) rounding 'remaining hours' to nearest hour then deriving elapsed = 168 - remaining injects up to 1h error and can jump backwards; (3) elapsed-marker vs percentage-fill drift: percentage comes from usage data (DB), elapsed marker comes from time - they measure different things and will disagree; (4) Double precision is fine for sub-ms, but truncating to Int hours at computation time (not display) accumulates error over 168h; (5) if marker = elapsed hours/168 and bar fill = usage %, the two only coincide when usage rate is linear - document that mismatch.
